option.description_controller_mode: Check this if you want to play with\na controller instead of using your Keyboard.
option.description_downscroll: If checked, notes go Down instead of Up, simple enough.
option.description_middlescroll: If checked, your notes get centered.
option.description_opponent_notes: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden during gameplay.
option.description_ghost_tapping: If checked, you won't get misses from pressing keys\nwhile there are no notes able to be hit.
option.description_auto_pause: If checked, the game automatically pauses if the screen isn't on focus.
option.description_results_screen: If checked, a results screen appears at the end\nof a week and every song in Freeplay.
option.description_disable_reset_button: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
option.description_hitsound_volume: Funny notes does \"Tick!\" when you hit them.
option.description_rating_offset: Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!"\nHigher values mean you have to hit later.
option.description_marvelous_hit_window: Changes the amount of time you have\nfor hitting a "Marvelous!!" in milliseconds.
option.description_sick_hit_window: Changes the amount of time you have\nfor hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.
option.description_good_hit_window: Changes the amount of time you have\nfor hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.
option.description_bad_hit_window: Changes the amount of time you have\nfor hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.
option.description_shit_hit_window: Changes the amount of time you have\nfor hitting a "Shit" in milliseconds.
option.description_safe_frames: Changes how many frames you have for\nhitting a note earlier or late.
option.description_low_quality: If checked, disables some background details,\ndecreases loading times and improves performance.
option.description_anti-aliasing: If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance\nat the cost of sharper visuals.
option.description_gpu_textures: If checked, textures will be pushed into GPU,\nreducing CPU memory usage.
option.description_hide_hud: If checked, hides most HUD elements.
option.description_subtitles: Enable and disable subtitles throughout the mod
option.description_time_bar: What should the Time Bar display?
option.description_flashing_lights: Uncheck this if you're sensitive to flashing lights!
option.description_score_text_zoom_on_hit: If unchecked, disables the Score text zooming\neverytime you hit a note.
option.description_health_bar_transparency: How much transparent should the health bar and icons be.
option.description_lane_transparency: How much transparent should the note lanes be.
option.description_timing_indicator: Shows the timing of the note that was hit.\nSimple: Displays either EARLY or LATE if not Marvelous\nPrecise: Displays note hit timing in milliseconds
option.description_nps_display: Shows your current Notes Per Second on the info bar.
option.description_judgement_counter: Show your judgements that you've gotten in the song.
option.description_fps_counter: If unchecked, hides the FPS Counter.
option.description_memory_counter: If unchecked, hides the Memory Counter.
option.description_peak_counter: If unchecked, hides the Peak Counter.
option.description_counter_border: If unchecked, disables the Counter Border, increases performance at the cost of readability.
option.description_watermarks: Enable and disable all watermarks from the engine.
option.description_mouse_navigation: Check this if you want to add\nthe ability to navigate Menus with your Mouse.
